notes: Template: ABox contraction of the premise of a derived revision (physics-replace-0015 edits "The electron was discovered in the United Kingdom", worked out from its discoverer and where he worked). The contraction has no derived edit, so it removes the revision's main stored premise, "The electron was discovered by J. J. Thomson" (has_discoverer: one discoverer per discovery, functional). Cardinality question: another candidate (Niels Bohr, a junior colleague of Thomson); "no" before because a discovery is credited to one discoverer, "does not know" after. Related near uses the inverse (has_discoverer is tagged inverse:discoverer_of). Related far and the two derived questions reach Thomson by the description "the scientist who discovered the electron" and look up a stored fact about him by name (the Cavendish Laboratory, his country of work, his 1906 Nobel Prize). The revision's questions about the country of discovery are not reused: they rest on the derived edit, not on the premise. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
